user.title: GitHub Authentication
user.description: Enter your GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained) with `repo` or `contents:read` scope.

repositories.title: Configure Repositories
repositories.description: Enter the private repositories you want to sync (one per line or comma-separated). You can specify branch with `@branch_name` (e.g. `owner/repo@dev`).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid Personal Access Token or permissions missing.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to GitHub API. Please check your network.
error.repo_not_found: Repository not found. Please verify the owner/repo name.
error.repo_forbidden: Access forbidden. Ensure the token has permission to access this private repository.

init.title: Manage Private Repositories
init.description: Update your GitHub Token or modify the monitored private repositories list.
